faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Website Development

items.question: What is web application development and how does it differ from a simple website?
items.answer: Web application development covers platforms with complex functionality: dashboards, booking systems, SaaS tools, portals. It is not a presentational page but a complete system built on React & Next.js.

items.question: How much does a website or web application cost?
items.answer: A professional website starts from {price:websiteStarter}, a custom e-shop from {price:eshop}. E-shops and web applications are priced according to their features. Request a free quote for an exact estimate.

items.question: How long does development take?
items.answer: A professional website is delivered in 2-4 weeks. Web applications take 4-12 weeks depending on complexity. Throughout the project you communicate directly with the developer.

items.question: Do you use WordPress or templates?
items.answer: For new projects we follow a custom approach with React & Next.js, without ready-made WordPress themes, Wix or page builders. Our portfolio also includes older projects built on other technologies, such as Physio Elpida from 2022.

items.question: Do you provide SEO optimization for websites?
items.answer: Yes. Every website is delivered with technical SEO: Core Web Vitals, schema markup, sitemap, robots.txt and on-page SEO tailored to the Greek market.
